(1) The management, control and administration of
the affairs of the Corporation shall, subject to the provisions
of this Act and the rules of the corporation made under section
6 of this Act, be administered by a Committee of Management

column2: consisting of not less than  five members.

column3: (2) No act or proceeding of the Committee of Management
shall be deemed to be invalid by reason only of the existence
of a vacancy among its members or  any defect on the election

column2: or nomination of a member thereof.

column3: (3) The first Committee of Management shall consist of
the members of the Committee of Management holding office
on the day immediately preceding the date of commencement
of  this  Act  and  shall  continue  to  hold  office  until  a  new
Committee  of  Management  is  elected  in  accordance  with

column2: the rules made under section 6 of this Act.
